proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3865 khādati gives khā-/khāv-/khāvan eat, including Palula khūm. Section 2 khādita expressly includes Nepali khāyo ate; the Dotyali past is assigned to that participle. Unclear p-bearing responses are held. Reviewed comparison: had kʰāo “eat!” (f_a5h4jtabxfpem). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
